lines.text: I read everything but never post!
I just lurk in that group chat.

data.define: To read posts in a group without joining in.

example.text: I just lurk in that group chat.

misuse.text: Don't tell your friend 'I lurk on your profile'.

hook.text: I read everything but never post!

publish.title: What does "lurk" mean?
publish.value: Lurk = Read online without posting. Example: "I just lurk in that group chat." (casual English).
